$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the shortcut hint settings (cx-d5b5d); gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: shortcutHints
lists.note: The Command/Control shortcut hint overlay; the same key as classic cmux.

rows.note: Shows hints when the configuration does not specify a preference.

title.text: Show Shortcuts When Holding a Modifier

help.text: Hold Command or Control for 0.30 seconds to show shortcut hints.

lists.name: keyboardLayout
lists.note: Which key a Command or Control shortcut means on a layout other than US QWERTY (Leo, 2026-11-16, ask-0c4c69aaac).

rows.note: typed: the letter the selected layout types (Cmd-T is the key that types t); qwerty: the US QWERTY key position, as macOS's Dvorak - QWERTY Command layout.

help.text: On Dvorak, Colemak or AZERTY, QWERTY Positions keeps Command and Control shortcuts on the keys they have on a US keyboard.
